endorsements.label: FirmWire: Taking Baseband Security Analysis to the Next Level
endorsements.description: This talk will provide an introduction to FirmWire, our open-source emulation platform for cellular baseband images. The platform allows researchers to dynamically debug, introspect, and interact with complex baseband firmware, providing insights about its inner workings in real-time.
